acceptanceCriteria: Cargo metadata and lockfile identify v0.2.68 while historical release facts remain unchanged.
A reviewed pull request from the latest synchronized default branch passes all required hosted checks before the annotated v0.2.68 tag is created.
The public Release assets, checksums, SBOM, provenance, and release manifest agree with the tagged commit and downloaded bytes.
The downloaded public artifact, with no source or workspace-binary fallback, passes isolated adopter and N-1 acceptance including first-adopter-smoke=not_ready and temporary-root cleanup.
The installed public v0.2.68 binary passes repository-bound inspect, status, doctor, and agent doctor checks on this repository.
Human Outcome, archive, finalization, close, documentation promotion, and exact branch/worktree cleanup are recorded and verified.
goal: Deliver a reproducible v0.2.68 public release with bound checksums, supply-chain metadata, release acceptance, installed-runtime verification, and clean Work Item closure.
intent: Publish v0.2.68 from the reviewed synchronized default branch and prove the immutable public release artifact can be installed and accepted without source or workspace fallback.
outOfScope: Runtime source behavior and protocol changes
Reference source implementation and object repository changes
Changing release or acceptance scripts unless a release-blocking defect is discovered and amended into this Contract

scenarioCoverage.expected: v0.2.68 metadata is consistent and release inputs remain bound to the exact reviewed commit without reusing a reserved tag.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run cargo metadata, version consistency, source archive, workflow policy, and full workspace checks before tagging.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Public archives, checksums, SBOM, provenance, and release manifest agree with the immutable v0.2.68 tag and downloaded bytes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After publication, download only public release assets, verify their digests, and run adopter and N-1 acceptance without source or workspace fallback.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The installed public binary passes repository-bound health checks and the Work Item closes with visible Outcome, promotion check, and exact cleanup.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Install the downloaded v0.2.68 binary, run inspect/status/doctor/agent doctor with explicit --repo, then verify archive, finalization, close, and documentation promotion.
